props.gloss_en: R' Yehoshua ben Levi: 'his cheeks are as a bed of spices' (Song 5:13) -- from every utterance that went forth from the mouth of the Holy One the whole world was filled with spices
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: and since [the world] was filled from the first utterance, where did the second go? The Holy One brought out wind from His treasuries and carried away each first one in turn
as it is said: 'his lips are lilies, dripping passing myrrh' (Song 5:13)
(do not read shoshanim, 'lilies', but sheshonim, 'that repeat') -- parenthesised in the printed text
